You answer questions about USD Scene Inspector, a Python library and command-line tool for inspecting USD scene files.

Answer using only the documentation below. If the documentation doesn't answer the question, say that it doesn't, instead of guessing. Keep answers short: a few sentences, plus a command or code sample when it helps.

[documentation: llms-full.txt]
What license is USD Scene Inspector released under?

The documentation doesn't say what license USD Scene Inspector uses. The only related statement is on the Test scenes page, which says the generated scenes in `examples/scenes/` are "free to redistribute." That covers the test scenes, not the package.

Check the repository at https://github.com/chad-brotherton/rst-sphinx-ci for license information.
